It's time to honor the greatest in the LCS! The LCS Summer Split Awards recognize players and coaches who showcased remarkable performance throughout the Summer Split and all year long. Stakes are rising as teams head closer to the LCS Championship Driven by Kia in Duluth, Georgia. If you haven’tgrabbed your tickets, there’s still time!

Fans can cast their ballots for Kia All-Pro Teams, Kia Summer Split MVP, and Kia Rookie of the Year at kialcsfanvote.com fromSeptember 4-13. By voting, you’ll also be entered for a chance to win a trip to the 2026 LCS Championship later this year (Terms apply).

Coaching Staff of the Split - September 10

Most Improved Player of the Year - September 10

Each Split, the LCS honors the most exceptional talent across the league. These awards recognize the coaches and players whose performance, mechanics, and teamwork stood out at the highest level of play in League of Legends.

Ballots open September 6-9 for the 2026 LCS Summer Split. The fan ballots open September 4-13.

Paul Delos Santos is a reporter based in Las Vegas. He covers the Vegas Golden Knights forNHL.comand also covers esports and general Las Vegas sports for The Sporting Tribune. He’s a gamer who never has time to play them, so he naturally opted to write and talk about them instead.

Olivia Richman is a seasoned esports journalist who has worked with Inven Global, Esports Illustrated, Esports.gg, and more. As an editor and writer at Esports Insider, she loves telling unique esports stories, especially within the FGC. When not working and gaming, Olivia loves collecting Kirby plush, eating sushi, and driving her cars at the track.

The North American Challengers League – North America’sLeague of LegendsTier 2 system – is in its home stretch.

Six teams remain in the NACL Summer Playoffs, but the prize isn’t merely a trophy. The top two teams qualify for the League Championship Series’ promotion-relegation tournament, set to happen later this year.

The finalists in the NACL Playoffs will join a pair of Liga Regional Norte teams and current LCS guest spot holder Disguised in a five-team event to qualify for North America’s Tier 1 system.

The lure of playing on stage in the LCS is enough to excite Cupid Esports coach Samuel “boc” Boudrie and his players.

Riot Games continues to refine the competitive structure, balancing the game's high skill ceiling with spectator entertainment. Speaking on the recent events, seasoned esports analysts noted that 'Vod  LoL Esports' is not just a temporary trend but a fundamental shift in how teams will approach their upcoming matchdays. 'Draft priority and map control are going to be completely redefined over the next few weeks,' remarked a prominent league caster. 'Teams that fail to recognize the gravity of this change will find themselves falling behind very quickly in the standings.'

As the community awaits the upcoming weekend matches, anticipation continues to build. Fans can catch all the high-stakes action live on official streaming channels, complete with expert desk analysis and live regional broadcasts. Perhaps enough fans spammed this static to help Fnatic.

Fnatic has been a consistent presence in the apex international events for both League of Legends and VALORANT. It was always an organization that European esports fans could rally behind. In 2026, though, a series of unfortunate match results caused Fnatic to break their streak of being at Worlds and Champions.

Fnatic was there when LoL Esports began. The org even picked up the win at the inaugural World Championship back in 2011. Since then, they’ve made it to almost every Worlds, missing only two iterations in 2012 and 2016.

The League of Legends Fnatic team didn’t have the best performance in the LEC 2026 Summer. The 10-team league needed them to place at sixth or higher to qualify for playoffs, but they just barely missed it. They ended the season at3W-6L, finishing the regular season atseventh place.

Granted, there was a glimmer of hope there after they took the series against their long-time rivals,G2 Esports. Their other two wins, however, were against bottom teamsShiftersandSK Gaming, and they dropped the series against all the other teams. Their do-or-die match against GIANTX sealed their fate —Fnatic would missWorlds, ending their nine-year streak of consecutive appearances.
